name: Floating action button
description: The one main action of a phone screen (New task, Compose, Scan), as a round button floating at the bottom inline-end corner over the content. Extended adds a label. Fixed to the viewport and clear of the home indicator; as a direct child of an App shell it sits in the shell's corner and above its bottom nav on phones.

classes.ayy-fab: A <button> (or <a>) with an icon and an aria-label: primary fill, a lifted shadow, size from data-density. position: fixed at the bottom inline-end corner. In an .ayy-app-shell, place it after __main and before the bottom nav.
classes.ayy-fab--extended: Icon and a visible label: a wider pill ("Compose"). Needs no aria-label.
classes.ayy-fab--secondary: A raised surface with a border instead of the primary fill: less emphasis.
classes.ayy-fab--sm: Smaller (the control-lg size), for a second action stacked above the main one.
classes.ayy-fab--inline: Not floating: in the flow, placed by its container (an empty state, a toolbar, a docs page).

default.looks: A round primary-colour button with a 20px icon and the lift shadow, fixed to the bottom inline-end corner clear of the home indicator.

hover.looks: The fill mixes 12% toward the label colour.

selected.none: A FAB runs an action; it has no on state. For a tool that stays on, use a Toolbar button with aria-pressed.

error.none: No error look. If the action fails, say so in a toast and leave the FAB as it was.

loading.none: Don't spin a FAB. Run the action and show progress where its result appears (a new row's Skeleton, a toast).

scale.sm: The lg control height: 40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch. A second action stacked above the main one.
scale.md: The lg control height plus 12px: 52px compact, 60 comfortable, 64 touch.

sizes.density: Its diameter follows data-density through the lg control height (the sizes above).
sizes.width: Square, a circle. extended (ayy-fab--extended) hugs its icon and label as a pill. Takes no room: it floats over the content (inline puts it back in the flow).

js: fabClass({ variant?, size?, extended?, inline?, className? }) → string; fabVariants, fabSizes.

props.extended: boolean — icon and a label; otherwise give it aria-label

a11y: An icon-only FAB needs an aria-label that says the action ("New task"), not the icon ("Plus").
Put it after the main content in the DOM so it comes after what it acts on in the tab order, not before the page.
It must not cover content for good: the App shell keeps it out of the bottom nav, and lists need room at their end (padding-block-end of the FAB's height) so the last row can scroll clear of it.
do: Use one FAB for the screen's main, constructive action: create, compose, scan, add.
Use extended when the action isn't obvious from an icon, or on the first screens of an app.
Hide it on screens where the main action is already on screen (a form's Save) or while a sheet is open.
dont: Don't use more than one main FAB; stack a small secondary one at most.
Don't put destructive or minor actions (Delete, Share, Settings) in a FAB — use a Top bar action or a Menu.
Don't use it on desktop layouts where a toolbar button fits better.

examples.title: In an app shell, above the bottom nav
